sources.title: Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Standard Bangla Grammar, Vols. 1-3)
sources.author_or_org: Rafiqul Islam, Pabitra Sarkar (Eds.) / Bangla Academy

verification.verifier_notes: Authoritative multi-volume national grammar defining standard BDSB morphology, syntax, and orthography. Derived rule extraction permitted.

sources.citation: Islam, R., & Sarkar, P. (Eds.). (2012). Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Vols. 1-3). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Authoritative baseline for morphosyntactic paradigms and canonical BDSB sentence constructions.

sources.title: Bangla Academy Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom (Standard Bangla Spelling Rules)
sources.author_or_org: Bangla Academy Banan Upo-Komiti

verification.verifier_notes: Authoritative standard for Bengali Unicode NFC normalization, vowel harmony orthography, and loanword spelling.

sources.citation: Bangla Academy. (2016). Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom. Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Directly implemented in blf.linguistics.normalizer for Unicode NFC string normalization.

sources.title: Bangladesher Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan (Regional Dialect Dictionary of Bangladesh)
sources.author_or_org: Muhammad Shahidullah (Ed.) / Bangla Academy

verification.verifier_notes: 3-volume catalog containing ~120,000 regional lexical entries across Bangladesh districts. Crucial for ground-truth dialect vocabulary.

sources.citation: Shahidullah, M. (Ed.). (1965). Purbo Pakistaner Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan [Bangladesher Ancholik Bhashar Abhidhan] (Vols. 1-3). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Primary reference preventing fabricated dialect words in regional realization models.

sources.title: Bangla Academy Bengali-English Dictionary (3rd Edition)
sources.author_or_org: Mohammad Ali, Khabir Ahmad et al. (Eds.) / Bangla Academy

verification.verifier_notes: Standard reference for bilingual translation equivalence, POS categorization, and idiomatic phrase mappings.

sources.citation: Ali, M., & Ahmad, K. (Eds.). (2019). Bangla Academy Bengali-English Dictionary (3rd ed.). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Used for lexeme-level translation grounding and semantic role mapping.

sources.title: The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language (ODBL)
sources.author_or_org: Suniti Kumar Chatterji

verification.verifier_notes: Foundational historical phonology and morphology treatise. Public domain.

sources.citation: Chatterji, S. K. (1926). The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language (Vols. 1-2). Calcutta: Calcutta University Press.
sources.notes: Theoretical foundation for morphological segmentation and historical Sadhu vs Cholit mappings.

sources.title: Bakkototto (Bangla Syntax)
sources.author_or_org: Humayun Azad

verification.verifier_notes: Pioneering formal generative syntactic analysis of Bangla constituent structure, topicalization, and passivization.

sources.citation: Azad, H. (1984). Bakkototto. Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Direct formal modeling of grammatical constructions, topicalization, and argument structures.

sources.title: Bengali: A Comprehensive Grammar
sources.author_or_org: Hanne-Ruth Thompson

verification.verifier_notes: Extensive empirical documentation of modern colloquial spoken Bangla, compound verbs, and pragmatic particles.

sources.citation: Thompson, H.-R. (2012). Bengali: A Comprehensive Grammar. London & New York: Routledge.
sources.notes: Used for designing pragmatic and discourse annotation guidelines for conversational sentence families.

sources.title: Universal Dependencies Bengali Treebank (UD_Bengali-BRU)
sources.author_or_org: Siratun Jannat, Mizanur Rahoman, Shafi Sourov et al. (Begum Rokeya University, Rangpur)

verification.verifier_notes: Official Bangladesh UD treebank (56 sentences, 320 tokens; Begum Rokeya University). Verified on Universal Dependencies official repository.

sources.citation: Jannat, S., Rahoman, M., Sourov, S., Ferdaousi, J., Shahzadi, S., & Zeman, D. (2021). Universal Dependencies Treebank for Bengali (UD_Bengali-BRU). In Universal Dependencies 2.9.
sources.notes: Verified official UD Bangladesh treebank. Demonstrates syntactic treebank gap (only 56 grammar-example sentences).

sources.title: Parallel Universal Dependencies (PUD) Bengali Treebank
sources.author_or_org: Universal Dependencies Contributors

verification.verifier_notes: 1,000 parallel sentences translated from English/German news and Wikipedia. Verified on Universal Dependencies official registry.

sources.citation: Universal Dependencies Consortium. (2017). Parallel Universal Dependencies (PUD) Treebank for Bengali. In Universal Dependencies 2.1.
sources.notes: Cross-lingual syntactic benchmark for parallel sentence parsing.

sources.title: Bangla2B+ / BanglaBERT Pretraining Corpus
sources.author_or_org: Tahmid Hasan, Abhik Bhattacharjee, Md. Saiful Islam et al. (BUET CSE NLP Group)

verification.verifier_notes: 27.5 GB corpus collected by BUET CSE NLP from 110 Bangladesh websites. Primary corpus for BanglaBERT and BanglaT5.

sources.citation: Hasan, T., Bhattacharjee, A., Islam, M. S., Mubasshir, K., Li, Y.-F., Kang, Y.-B., Rahman, M. S., & Shahriyar, R. (2022). Not Low-Resource Anymore: Pretrained Language Models for Bengali. Proceedings of NAACL 2022, 2612-2626.
sources.notes: Large-scale Bangladesh web corpus for pretraining baselines and lexical statistics.

sources.title: BanglaNMT: Bengali-English Parallel Corpus
sources.author_or_org: Tahmid Hasan, Abhik Bhattacharjee, Kazi Mubasshir et al. (BUET CSE NLP Group)

verification.verifier_notes: 2.75M parallel sentence pairs for Bengali-English MT curated by BUET CSE NLP group with batch filtering and aligner ensembling.

sources.citation: Hasan, T., Bhattacharjee, A., Mubasshir, K., Islam, M. S., Li, Y.-F., Kang, Y.-B., Rahman, M. S., & Shahriyar, R. (2020). Not Low-Resource Anymore: Aligner Ensembling, Batch Filtering, and New Datasets for Bengali-English Machine Translation. Proceedings of EMNLP 2020, 2612-2623.
sources.notes: Standard curated benchmark for Bengali-English parallel translation.

sources.title: IndicCorp v2 (Bengali Web Crawl Split)
sources.author_or_org: AI4Bharat / IIT Madras (Divyanshu Kakwani et al.)

verification.verifier_notes: 1.2B tokens web crawl corpus released under CC0. Useful for statistical n-gram distribution checks.

sources.citation: Kakwani, D., Kunchukuttan, A., Golla, S., Gokul, N. C., Bhattacharyya, A., Khapra, M. M., & Kumar, P. (2020). IndicNLPSuite: Monolingual Corpora, Evaluation Benchmarks and Pre-trained Multilingual Language Models for Indian Languages. Findings of EMNLP 2020, 4948-4961.
sources.notes: Large-scale web crawl corpus for token frequency distributions.

sources.title: Bengali Common Voice Speech Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
sources.author_or_org: Samiul Alam, Asif Sushmit, Zaowad Abdullah et al. (Bengali.AI Consortium)

verification.verifier_notes: Authoritative crowdsourced speech corpus covering multiregional Bangladesh accents and phonetic distributions (Alam et al., 2022). Verified on arXiv:2206.14053.

sources.citation: Alam, S., Sushmit, A., Abdullah, Z., Nakkhatra, S., Ansary, M. N., Hossen, S. M., Mehnaz, S. M., Reasat, T., & Humayun, A. I. (2022). Bengali Common Voice Speech Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition. arXiv preprint arXiv:2206.14053.
sources.notes: Verified primary speech corpus for Bangladesh accents and phonetic realization.

sources.title: BanglaTLit: A Benchmark Dataset for Back-Transliteration of Romanized Bangla
sources.author_or_org: Md Fahim, Fariha Tanjim Shifat, Fabiha Haider, Deeparghya Dutta Barua, MD Sakib Ul Rahman Sourove, Md Farhan Ishmam, Md Farhad Alam Bhuiyan

verification.verifier_notes: 42.7k annotated back-transliteration pairs + 245.7k sample pre-training corpus (BanglaTLit-PT). Verified EMNLP 2024 benchmark.

sources.citation: Fahim, M., Shifat, F. T., Haider, F., Barua, D. D., Sourove, M. S. U. R., Ishmam, M. F., & Bhuiyan, M. F. A. (2024). BanglaTLit: A Benchmark Dataset for Back-Transliteration of Romanized Bangla. Findings of EMNLP 2024, 14660-14674.
sources.notes: Verified primary benchmark for Romanized Bangla back-transliteration.

sources.title: BnSentMix: A Diverse Bengali-English Code-Mixed Dataset for Sentiment Analysis
sources.author_or_org: Sadia Alam, Md Farhan Ishmam, Navid Hasin Alvee, Md Shahnewaz Siddique, Md Azam Hossain, Abu Raihan Mostofa Kamal

verification.verifier_notes: 20,000 samples of authentic Bengali-English code-mixed social media text annotated across 4 sentiment classes. Verified at LoResLM 2025.

sources.citation: Alam, S., Ishmam, M. F., Alvee, N. H., Siddique, M. S., Hossain, M. A., & Kamal, A. R. M. (2025). BnSentMix: A Diverse Bengali-English Code-Mixed Dataset for Sentiment Analysis. Proceedings of the First Workshop on Language Models for Low-Resource Languages (LoResLM 2025), 32-44.
sources.notes: Verified primary dataset for Bangladesh code-mixed social text distributions.

sources.title: Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection (BPCC) — Bengali Parallel Component
sources.author_or_org: AI4Bharat / IIT Madras (Gowtham Ramesh et al.)

verification.verifier_notes: Part of 230M Indic bitext collection. Bengali component contains mined + human-translated subsets. Exact token count for Bengali isolated split pending local extraction.

sources.citation: Ramesh, G., Chitale, P. A., et al. (2023). IndicTrans2: Towards High-Quality and Accessible Machine Translation for Indian Languages. Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR).
sources.notes: Multilingual parallel corpus; Bengali subset separated from aggregate Indic statistics.

sources.title: The SOAS Sylheti Project: Documenting and Describing the Sylheti Language
sources.author_or_org: Candide Simard, Sarah Dopierala, Ewa Thorsen (SOAS University of London)

verification.verifier_notes: Peer-reviewed documentation of the SOAS Sylheti Project describing phonetic, tonal, and morphosyntactic features of Sylheti. Corrected from ungrounded archive code.

sources.citation: Simard, C., Dopierala, S., & Thorsen, E. (2014). The SOAS Sylheti Project: Documenting and describing the Sylheti language. Language Documentation and Description, 12, 156-168.
sources.notes: Verified primary academic reference for Sylheti linguistic features.
